plugins.name: day-trader-india
plugins.description: Nine Claude skills for day trading on the NSE: a chart scanner for the Nifty indices, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner (flat by 3:15), a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager in rupees, an order ticket you place yourself, and price alerts.
